rows.check: Not yet seen; find which source field shows an eviction before changing a rule
rows.checkResult: The source field is the RentVine lease status: each lease's leaseStatusID resolved through GET /leases/statuses, where an eviction in progress is a status whose isPendingMoveOutStatus flag is set (lib/lease-renewal/move-out-disposition.ts) and a finished one is a closed status (primaryLeaseStatusID 3). R-S246-1 and R-S246-4 already read those: a pending move-out goes to the non-renewal handoff and a closed status to Not renewal targets. The operating Sheet's free-text status can also carry the word eviction (lib/lease-renewal/normalized-value.ts), which no target rule reads. The November 5 mix has no eviction status, so it is not reproduced here. No rule was changed.

result.reason: Reported, not reproduced: the account's own eviction status name and flags are needed to confirm the report, read only, by staff in RentVine. No rule is changed until then.
